# Configuration

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(fs)
library(cli)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# --- User configuration ---

# Email for polite API access (Crossref polite pool + Unpaywall)
email <- "your.name@unibe.ch"  # TODO: set your institutional email

# API keys (loaded from .Renviron — see .Renviron.example)
elsevier_api_key <- Sys.getenv("ELSEVIER_API_KEY", unset = "")
wiley_tdm_token  <- Sys.getenv("WILEY_TDM_TOKEN", unset = "")

# Path to local APA HTML files (set to NULL if not yet received)
# When available, set to the directory containing APA HTMLs.
# Files should be named or matchable by DOI.
apa_html_dir <- NULL  # e.g., "../data/06 apa_htmls/"

# --- Paths ---
input_file       <- "../data/04 processed/data_processed_subset_testing.csv"
article_dir      <- "../data/05 articles"
log_file         <- file.path(article_dir, "download_log.csv")
crossref_cache   <- file.path(article_dir, "crossref_metadata_cache.csv")

# --- Rate limiting ---
rate_delay <- 1  # seconds between requests

# Create output directory
fs::dir_create(article_dir)

```

# Load DOIs to download

```{r}

data_to_download <- read_csv(input_file) |>
  distinct(DOI, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(!is.na(DOI), DOI != "")

message(sprintf("Loaded %d unique DOIs to download", nrow(data_to_download)))

```

# Crossref metadata enrichment

Fetch `publisher` and TDM `link` URLs for each DOI from the Crossref REST API. Results are cached so this only runs once.

```{r}

fetch_crossref_metadata <- function(doi, email) {
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request(paste0("https://api.crossref.org/works/", URLencode(doi, reserved = TRUE))) |>
      req_headers(`User-Agent` = paste0("R/httr2 (mailto:", email, "; academic research)")) |>
      req_timeout(30) |>
      req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
      req_perform()

    if (resp_status(resp) != 200) {
      return(tibble(DOI = doi, publisher = NA_character_, tdm_url = NA_character_))
    }

    msg <- resp_body_json(resp)$message

    # Extract publisher
    publisher <- msg$publisher %||% NA_character_

    # Extract best TDM/PDF link
    tdm_url <- NA_character_
    if (!is.null(msg$link) && length(msg$link) > 0) {
      # Prefer PDF links intended for text-mining
      for (lnk in msg$link) {
        ct <- lnk$`content-type` %||% ""
        ia <- lnk$`intended-application` %||% ""
        if (grepl("pdf", ct, ignore.case = TRUE) || ia == "text-mining") {
          tdm_url <- lnk$URL %||% NA_character_
          break
        }
      }
      # Fall back to first link if no PDF-specific one found
      if (is.na(tdm_url)) {
        tdm_url <- msg$link[[1]]$URL %||% NA_character_
      }
    }

    tibble(DOI = doi, publisher = publisher, tdm_url = tdm_url)
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(DOI = doi, publisher = NA_character_, tdm_url = NA_character_)
  })
}

# Load cache or fetch
if (file.exists(crossref_cache)) {
  crossref_meta <- read_csv(crossref_cache, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
  dois_to_fetch <- setdiff(data_to_download$DOI, crossref_meta$DOI)
} else {
  crossref_meta <- tibble(DOI = character(), publisher = character(), tdm_url = character())
  dois_to_fetch <- data_to_download$DOI
}

if (length(dois_to_fetch) > 0) {
  message(sprintf("Fetching Crossref metadata for %d DOIs...", length(dois_to_fetch)))
  cli_progress_bar("Crossref metadata", total = length(dois_to_fetch))

  new_records <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(dois_to_fetch)) {
    new_records[[i]] <- fetch_crossref_metadata(dois_to_fetch[i], email)
    Sys.sleep(rate_delay)
    cli_progress_update()

    # Flush to cache every 500 records
    if (i %% 500 == 0) {
      batch <- bind_rows(new_records)
      crossref_meta <- bind_rows(crossref_meta, batch)
      write_csv(crossref_meta, crossref_cache)
      new_records <- list()
      message(sprintf("  Cached %d/%d", i, length(dois_to_fetch)))
    }
  }

  # Final flush
  if (length(new_records) > 0) {
    batch <- bind_rows(new_records)
    crossref_meta <- bind_rows(crossref_meta, batch)
    write_csv(crossref_meta, crossref_cache)
  }

  cli_progress_done()
}

# Join metadata to download list
data_to_download <- data_to_download |>
  left_join(crossref_meta |> select(DOI, publisher, tdm_url), by = "DOI")

message(sprintf("Publisher info available for %d/%d DOIs",
                sum(!is.na(data_to_download$publisher)), nrow(data_to_download)))
message(sprintf("TDM URLs available for %d/%d DOIs",
                sum(!is.na(data_to_download$tdm_url)), nrow(data_to_download)))

```

# Download helper functions

```{r}

# --- File validation ---

is_valid_pdf <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.size(path) < 1000) return(FALSE)
  con <- file(path, "rb")
  on.exit(close(con))
  header <- readBin(con, "raw", 5)
  identical(header, charToRaw("%PDF-"))
}

is_valid_html <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.size(path) < 1000) return(FALSE)
  first_bytes <- readLines(path, n = 5, warn = FALSE) |> paste(collapse = " ")
  grepl("<html|<!DOCTYPE", first_bytes, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

safe_filename <- function(doi) {
  gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_", doi)
}

# --- Strategy 0: Local APA HTMLs ---

try_apa_local <- function(doi, publisher, apa_html_dir) {
  if (is.null(apa_html_dir) || is.na(publisher)) {
    return(list(success = FALSE, method = "apa_local", path = NA_character_))
  }
  if (!grepl("American Psychological Association", publisher, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(list(success = FALSE, method = "apa_local", path = NA_character_))
  }

  # Try to find a matching file by DOI
  safe_name <- safe_filename(doi)
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(apa_html_dir, paste0(safe_name, ".html")),
    file.path(apa_html_dir, paste0(doi, ".html")),  # if stored with slashes
    file.path(apa_html_dir, paste0(safe_name, ".htm"))
  )

  for (candidate in candidates) {
    if (file.exists(candidate) && file.size(candidate) > 1000) {
      return(list(success = TRUE, method = "apa_local", path = candidate))
    }
  }

  # Fallback: search by partial DOI match in filenames
  if (dir.exists(apa_html_dir)) {
    all_files <- list.files(apa_html_dir, pattern = "\\.(html?|htm)$", full.names = TRUE)
    doi_suffix <- sub("^.*/", "", doi)  # part after last /
    matches <- all_files[grepl(doi_suffix, all_files, fixed = TRUE)]
    if (length(matches) > 0) {
      return(list(success = TRUE, method = "apa_local", path = matches[1]))
    }
  }

  list(success = FALSE, method = "apa_local", path = NA_character_)
}

# --- Strategy 1: TDM link from Crossref ---

try_tdm_link <- function(doi, tdm_url, dest_path, email) {
  if (is.na(tdm_url) || tdm_url == "") {
    return(list(success = FALSE, method = "tdm_link"))
  }

  tryCatch({
    resp <- request(tdm_url) |>
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = paste0("R/httr2 (mailto:", email, "; academic research)"),
        Accept = "application/pdf"
      ) |>
      req_timeout(60) |>
      req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
      req_perform()

    if (resp_status(resp) == 200) {
      writeBin(resp_body_raw(resp), dest_path)
      if (is_valid_pdf(dest_path) || is_valid_html(dest_path)) {
        return(list(success = TRUE, method = "tdm_link"))
      }
      file.remove(dest_path)
    }
    list(success = FALSE, method = "tdm_link")
  }, error = function(e) list(success = FALSE, method = "tdm_link", message = e$message))
}

# --- Strategy 2: Unpaywall ---

try_unpaywall <- function(doi, dest_path, email) {
  tryCatch({
    api_url <- paste0("https://api.unpaywall.org/v2/",
                       URLencode(doi, reserved = TRUE),
                       "?email=", URLencode(email))
    resp <- request(api_url) |>
      req_headers(`User-Agent` = paste0("R/httr2 (mailto:", email, ")")) |>
      req_timeout(30) |>
      req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
      req_perform()

    if (resp_status(resp) != 200) {
      return(list(success = FALSE, method = "unpaywall"))
    }

    data <- resp_body_json(resp)

    # Try best_oa_location first, then oa_locations
    pdf_url <- data$best_oa_location$url_for_pdf
    if (is.null(pdf_url)) {
      for (loc in (data$oa_locations %||% list())) {
        if (!is.null(loc$url_for_pdf)) {
          pdf_url <- loc$url_for_pdf
          break
        }
      }
    }
    if (is.null(pdf_url)) {
      return(list(success = FALSE, method = "unpaywall"))
    }

    # Download the article
    pdf_resp <- request(pdf_url) |>
      req_headers(Accept = "application/pdf") |>
      req_timeout(60) |>
      req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
      req_perform()

    if (resp_status(pdf_resp) == 200) {
      writeBin(resp_body_raw(pdf_resp), dest_path)
      if (is_valid_pdf(dest_path) || is_valid_html(dest_path)) {
        return(list(success = TRUE, method = "unpaywall"))
      }
      file.remove(dest_path)
    }
    list(success = FALSE, method = "unpaywall")
  }, error = function(e) list(success = FALSE, method = "unpaywall", message = e$message))
}

# --- Strategy 3: Publisher-specific APIs ---

try_elsevier <- function(doi, dest_path, api_key) {
  if (api_key == "") return(list(success = FALSE, method = "elsevier_api"))
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request(paste0("https://api.elsevier.com/content/article/doi/", doi)) |>
      req_headers(
        `X-ELS-APIKey` = api_key,
        Accept = "application/pdf"
      ) |>
      req_timeout(60) |>
      req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
      req_perform()

    if (resp_status(resp) == 200) {
      writeBin(resp_body_raw(resp), dest_path)
      if (is_valid_pdf(dest_path)) {
        return(list(success = TRUE, method = "elsevier_api"))
      }
      file.remove(dest_path)
    }
    list(success = FALSE, method = "elsevier_api")
  }, error = function(e) list(success = FALSE, method = "elsevier_api", message = e$message))
}

try_wiley <- function(doi, dest_path, token) {
  if (token == "") return(list(success = FALSE, method = "wiley_tdm"))
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request(paste0("https://api.wiley.com/onlinelibrary/tdm/v1/articles/",
                            URLencode(doi, reserved = TRUE))) |>
      req_headers(
        `Wiley-TDM-Client-Token` = token,
        Accept = "application/pdf"
      ) |>
      req_timeout(60) |>
      req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
      req_perform()

    if (resp_status(resp) == 200) {
      writeBin(resp_body_raw(resp), dest_path)
      if (is_valid_pdf(dest_path)) {
        return(list(success = TRUE, method = "wiley_tdm"))
      }
      file.remove(dest_path)
    }
    list(success = FALSE, method = "wiley_tdm")
  }, error = function(e) list(success = FALSE, method = "wiley_tdm", message = e$message))
}

try_springer <- function(doi, dest_path) {
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request(paste0("https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/",
                            URLencode(doi, reserved = TRUE), ".pdf")) |>
      req_headers(Accept = "application/pdf") |>
      req_timeout(60) |>
      req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
      req_perform()

    if (resp_status(resp) == 200 && grepl("pdf", resp_content_type(resp), ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      writeBin(resp_body_raw(resp), dest_path)
      if (is_valid_pdf(dest_path)) {
        return(list(success = TRUE, method = "springer_direct"))
      }
      file.remove(dest_path)
    }
    list(success = FALSE, method = "springer_direct")
  }, error = function(e) list(success = FALSE, method = "springer_direct", message = e$message))
}

try_publisher_api <- function(doi, publisher, dest_path,
                               elsevier_key, wiley_token) {
  publisher_lower <- tolower(publisher %||% "")

  if (grepl("elsevier", publisher_lower)) {
    return(try_elsevier(doi, dest_path, elsevier_key))
  } else if (grepl("wiley", publisher_lower)) {
    return(try_wiley(doi, dest_path, wiley_token))
  } else if (grepl("springer|nature", publisher_lower)) {
    return(try_springer(doi, dest_path))
  }

  list(success = FALSE, method = "publisher_api")
}

# --- Strategy 4: DOI content negotiation ---

try_content_negotiation <- function(doi, dest_path, email) {
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request(paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)) |>
      req_headers(
        Accept = "application/pdf",
        `User-Agent` = paste0("R/httr2 (mailto:", email, "; academic research)")
      ) |>
      req_timeout(60) |>
      req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
      req_perform()

    if (resp_status(resp) == 200) {
      writeBin(resp_body_raw(resp), dest_path)
      if (is_valid_pdf(dest_path) || is_valid_html(dest_path)) {
        return(list(success = TRUE, method = "content_negotiation"))
      }
      file.remove(dest_path)
    }
    list(success = FALSE, method = "content_negotiation")
  }, error = function(e) list(success = FALSE, method = "content_negotiation", message = e$message))
}

```

# Main download orchestrator

```{r}

download_article <- function(doi, publisher = NA, tdm_url = NA,
                              article_dir, email, apa_html_dir,
                              elsevier_key, wiley_token) {
  safe_name <- safe_filename(doi)
  dest_path <- file.path(article_dir, paste0(safe_name, ".pdf"))

  # Skip if already downloaded
  existing <- list.files(article_dir, pattern = paste0("^", safe_name, "\\."),
                          full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(existing) > 0 && any(file.size(existing) > 1000)) {
    return(tibble(DOI = doi, success = TRUE, method = "already_exists",
                   file_path = existing[1], message = ""))
  }

  # Strategy 0: Local APA HTMLs
  result <- try_apa_local(doi, publisher, apa_html_dir)
  if (isTRUE(result$success)) {
    # Copy or symlink local file to article_dir
    ext <- tools::file_ext(result$path)
    local_dest <- file.path(article_dir, paste0(safe_name, ".", ext))
    file.copy(result$path, local_dest, overwrite = FALSE)
    return(tibble(DOI = doi, success = TRUE, method = "apa_local",
                   file_path = local_dest, message = ""))
  }

  # Strategy 1: TDM link
  result <- try_tdm_link(doi, tdm_url, dest_path, email)
  if (isTRUE(result$success)) {
    return(tibble(DOI = doi, success = TRUE, method = "tdm_link",
                   file_path = dest_path, message = ""))
  }

  # Strategy 2: Unpaywall
  result <- try_unpaywall(doi, dest_path, email)
  if (isTRUE(result$success)) {
    return(tibble(DOI = doi, success = TRUE, method = "unpaywall",
                   file_path = dest_path, message = ""))
  }

  # Strategy 3: Publisher API
  result <- try_publisher_api(doi, publisher, dest_path,
                               elsevier_key, wiley_token)
  if (isTRUE(result$success)) {
    return(tibble(DOI = doi, success = TRUE, method = result$method,
                   file_path = dest_path, message = ""))
  }

  # Strategy 4: DOI content negotiation (fallback)
  result <- try_content_negotiation(doi, dest_path, email)
  if (isTRUE(result$success)) {
    return(tibble(DOI = doi, success = TRUE, method = "content_negotiation",
                   file_path = dest_path, message = ""))
  }

  tibble(DOI = doi, success = FALSE, method = "all_failed",
          file_path = NA_character_, message = result$message %||% "")
}

```

# Run downloads

```{r}

# Load existing log to support resumption
if (file.exists(log_file)) {
  existing_log <- read_csv(log_file, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
  already_done <- existing_log |> filter(success == "TRUE") |> pull(DOI)
  data_remaining <- data_to_download |> filter(!DOI %in% already_done)
  message(sprintf("Resuming: %d already done, %d remaining",
                  length(already_done), nrow(data_remaining)))
} else {
  data_remaining <- data_to_download
  message(sprintf("Starting fresh: %d DOIs to download", nrow(data_remaining)))
}

# Download loop
if (nrow(data_remaining) > 0) {
  results <- list()
  cli_progress_bar("Downloading articles", total = nrow(data_remaining))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(data_remaining))) {
    row <- data_remaining[i, ]

    result <- download_article(
      doi          = row$DOI,
      publisher    = row$publisher %||% NA_character_,
      tdm_url      = row$tdm_url %||% NA_character_,
      article_dir  = article_dir,
      email        = email,
      apa_html_dir = apa_html_dir,
      elsevier_key = elsevier_api_key,
      wiley_token  = wiley_tdm_token
    )

    result$timestamp <- as.character(Sys.time())
    results[[i]] <- result

    # Flush to log every 100 records for crash resilience
    if (i %% 100 == 0) {
      batch <- bind_rows(results)
      write_csv(batch, log_file, append = file.exists(log_file))
      results <- list()

      n_success <- batch |> filter(success == TRUE) |> nrow()
      message(sprintf("  Progress: %d/%d | Batch success: %d/100",
                      i, nrow(data_remaining), n_success))
    }

    # Polite rate limiting
    Sys.sleep(rate_delay)
    cli_progress_update()
  }

  # Write remaining results
  if (length(results) > 0) {
    batch <- bind_rows(results)
    write_csv(batch, log_file, append = file.exists(log_file))
  }

  cli_progress_done()
}

```

# Summary report

```{r}

if (file.exists(log_file)) {
  log_data <- read_csv(log_file, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
    mutate(success = as.logical(success))

  # Overall success rate
  message(sprintf("\nOverall: %d/%d successful (%.1f%%)",
                  sum(log_data$success), nrow(log_data),
                  sum(log_data$success) / nrow(log_data) * 100))

  # By method
  log_data |>
    count(success, method) |>
    arrange(desc(success), desc(n)) |>
    kable(caption = "Download results by method") |>
    kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)
}

```

```{r}

if (file.exists(log_file)) {
  # Success rate by publisher
  data_to_download |>
    left_join(log_data |> select(DOI, success, method), by = "DOI") |>
    group_by(publisher) |>
    summarize(
      total = n(),
      downloaded = sum(success == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(downloaded / total * 100, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    kable(caption = "Success rate by publisher") |>
    kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)
}

```

```{r}

if (file.exists(log_file)) {
  # List failed DOIs for manual investigation
  failed_dois <- log_data |>
    filter(!success) |>
    left_join(data_to_download |> select(DOI, publisher, journal, title), by = "DOI")

  if (nrow(failed_dois) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("\n%d DOIs failed to download:", nrow(failed_dois)))

    failed_dois |>
      count(publisher, name = "n_failed") |>
      arrange(desc(n_failed)) |>
      kable(caption = "Failed downloads by publisher") |>
      kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)

    write_csv(failed_dois, file.path(article_dir, "failed_downloads.csv"))
    message("Full list saved to: ", file.path(article_dir, "failed_downloads.csv"))
  }
}
```
